description:
Get instant answers about professional padel.

Look up any player's profile, ranking history and career stats. Compare head-to-head records between players or pairs. Explore tournament results, match scores, detailed match statistics and point-by-point breakdowns. Simulate matchups based on real performance data. Coverage spans the Premier Padel and FIP circuit, plus historical World Padel Tour and Pro Padel Tour data.

Powered by Padel API.

defaultPrompt: How many titles have Tapia and Coello won together?
